frames.text:
You can switch between 
section tabs to view which 
parts are currently 
available to you to use 
during tank creation.

Drag a tank part from 
this box onto the stage
with your mouse.

Your current building- 
restrictions are displayed 
and updated as you add 
new parts to the stage.

You can arrange, align, 
and remove with ease 
by using these buttons.

You can scale and 
rotate parts using these 
sliders.
You can toggle 
symmetric mode on and 
off for easy editting.
